'''Bantha Bob PPD 10: Venerable Koensayr Y-Wings''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bantha Bob]]
* '''Published:''' 15 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif|label=Dantooine Base Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dantooine Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Dantooine Base Operations Bob LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

GPN member built.

The published list has 68 cards.

== Strategy ==

I'm pretty happy with the way this deck turned out. Build Dantooine, deploy your systems, flip DBO, Have fun!!
